 Arkansas basketball vs. Robert Morris.: How to watch, betting line, what to know
 November 10, 2026 at 4:23 p.m.
 by 
 Anthony Kristensen 
 Arkansas guard Billy Richmond (24), guard Jordan Smith (23), guard Jeremiah Wilkinson (5) and forward Miikka Muurinen (3) gather during a stoppage in play, Tuesday, Nov. 3, 2026, during the first half of the Razorbacks' 106-61 season-opening win over Arkansas-Pine Bluff at Bud Walton Arena in Fayetteville. (Hank Layton/WholeHogSports) 
 SCHEDULED GAME TIME 
 Wednesday at 7 p.m. at Bud Walton Arena (19,200) in Fayetteville
 COACHES 
 Arkansas: John Calipari — 51-24 in third season at Arkansas and 906-287 in 35th season overall.
 Robert Morris: Andy Toole — 274-254 in 17th season at Robert Morris and overall.
 SERIES HISTORY 
 Arkansas leads 1-0
 LAST MEETING 
 Arkansas defeated Robert Morris 79-75 on Dec. 20, 2012, at Bud Walton Arena
 TELEVISION AND STREAMING 
 The game will be streamed on ESPN+ and SEC Network+, which can be accessed on WatchESPN.com and via the ESPN app (subscriber login required). Brett Dolan (play-by-play) and Manuale Watkins (analysis) will be on the call.
 RADIO 
 Chuck Barrett (play-by-play) and Matt Zimmerman (analyst) will call the game on the Razorback Sports Network, available through local FM and AM affiliates and the Varsity Network app. Blackouts may apply.
 BETTING LINE 
 Arkansas is a 28 1/2-point favorite, according to FanDuel.
 STREAKS 
 Arkansas: Lost 1
 Robert Morris: Lost 2
 LAST GAME 
 Arkansas: 91-72 loss to Virginia
 Robert Morris: 79-56 loss to Illinois-Chicago
 LAST STARTING LINEUPS 
 Arkansas (vs. Virginia): Jordan Smith, Jeremiah Wilkinson, Billy Richmond, Miikka Muurinen, Cooper Bowser
 Robert Morris (vs. Illinois-Chicago): Ace Valentine, Eddie Cook, KC Ugwuakazi, Ta’Zir Smith, KJ Garris
 NOTABLE 
 • Though Wednesday will be the second time Arkansas and Robert Morris have met, it will be the fourth time coach John Calipari has coached against the Colonials. Each of the first three games were with Kentucky, and he has won each of the past two. The first was a famous upset loss to RMU in the 2013 NIT first round .
 • Robert Morris is located in Moon Township, Pennsylvania, which is Calipari’s hometown. Speaking on his  weekly radio show on Monday , he said “I could hit two 5-irons from my house and hit Robert Morris.”
 • Arkansas and Robert Morris play different styles of play. The Razorbacks want to play fast and get out in transition while the Colonials play more of a halfcourt, slower pace of play.
 • The Razorbacks return one player from last season’s rotation in Billy Richmond. Arkansas signed 10 newcomers, including eight freshmen. The Razorbacks have the youngest team in the power conferences and the fifth-youngest in Division I men’s basketball, per RotoWire. Robert Morris returns four rotational players — Darius Livingston, Eddie Cook, Samuel Obenjo and Ta’Zir Smith — from last season.
 • Last season, Arkansas won the SEC Tournament and reached its second consecutive NCAA Tournament Sweet 16. The Razorbacks finished 28-9. Robert Morris finished 22-11 and reached the Horizon League Tournament semifinals.
 • Arkansas was picked to finish third in the SEC preseason media poll. Robert Morris was picked to finish second behind Wright State in the preseason Horizon League poll.
 • Arkansas is ranked No. 19 in the AP Top 25 while Robert Morris is unranked. The Razorbacks are No. 28 on KenPom while the Colonials are No. 222. KenPom gives Arkansas a 98% chance to win.
